Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner arbitrarily chose to resolve ambiguity by using the “most recent judge appearance (including guest-judge roles)” heuristic, shifting the target from Nicki Minaj’s actual judge role on American Idol (hosted by Ryan Seacrest) to a guest-judge spot on RuPaul’s Drag Race (hosted by RuPaul). This misinterpretation set the wrong objective for subsequent steps and directly led to the incorrect final answer.
